versionLocalization.promotionalText: Continue your conversations across iPhone Duo, iPhone, and Apple Watch. Bring your own AI connection, use supported web search, and try optional voice input and playback.
versionLocalization.description:
Bring your own AI connection to iPhone and Apple Watch. WristChatUI lets you chat with a compatible service, use optional web search, and keep your conversations and returned source details together.

YOUR CONNECTION, YOUR CHOICE
Configure a base URL, model and any required API key. Choose OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages format for a compatible provider or gateway.

WEB SEARCH WHEN YOU NEED IT
Turn Web search on for a supported connection and model. Native search lets the model decide when to use the service's search tool. Or explicitly select a separate MiniMax plan search source or a search tool on your remote HTTPS MCP server. Your chosen chat model uses the returned references to answer.

ADAPTS TO IPHONE DUO
Use a conversation sidebar in wider windows and a focused chat on the outer display. Read at a comfortable width and keep unsent drafts and search choices while the layout changes.

OPTIONAL VOICE
Dictate questions on iPhone and listen to completed replies on iPhone and Apple Watch. Choose language, speed and automatic playback separately on each device. Microphone and speech access are requested when needed; automatic reply playback starts off.

SEE THE SEARCH STATUS
Distinguish an ordinary answer, retrieved reference material, successful search and an interrupted request. View source details and citation links when returned by your configured service.

MADE FOR THE WRIST
Start a chat with native Watch input or dictation. Read short paragraphs, lists and code on the small display. Watch complications, the Smart Stack widget and Siri Shortcuts help you start a new conversation.

RECOVER WITHOUT LOSING THE QUESTION
Stop an active response, retain a clearly labeled partial reply, or Retry the original question after a timeout. Retry replaces the interrupted reply without duplicating your question. Compact iPhone chats keep the conversation clear of the tab bar, while wider layouts keep navigation accessible.

KEEP YOUR DEVICES TOGETHER
Sync connection profiles, securely stored keys and chats with your paired Watch. Optionally back up and restore conversations through iCloud Drive, including compact source information.

WristChatUI does not provide an AI subscription or ChatGPT subscription sign-in. Bring a compatible endpoint and any account or credentials it requires. Provider, model, plan, region and server capabilities determine search availability and usage charges. Independent search services have their own authentication and availability. A compatible Chat Completions endpoint does not automatically support native search. Watch network access depends on its available connection and your configured service.

No developer-operated chat/search backend or analytics service. Read the privacy policy for configured-service data flows, paired-device sync and optional backups.
versionLocalization.whatsNew:
Ready for iPhone Duo, with a conversation sidebar in wider layouts and a focused chat on the outer display.

• Keep unsent drafts and search choices while the layout changes.
• Enjoy comfortable reading widths and easier-to-reach chat controls.
• Dictate questions on iPhone and listen to completed replies on iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Choose native web search or a configured MiniMax plan or remote MCP search source.
• View returned source details and citation links.
• Read clearer paragraphs, lists and code on Apple Watch.
• Recover interrupted replies with Stop and Retry without duplicating your question.
• Includes connection and search reliability improvements.

Search availability depends on your configured service and model. CarPlay is not included in this build.
